---
name: Feature request
about: Request a new feature or modification to an existing feature.
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: feature
assignees: ""
---

## Feature location

Describe where the feature should be added or which part of the system should be modified.

<!-- Example: Posts, comments, profiles, notifications, authentication, projects, etc. -->

## Motivation

Explain why this feature is needed and what problem it solves.

## How the feature works

Describe how the feature should work from the user's perspective.

## Related requirements

List the functional and/or non-functional requirements related to this feature.

<!-- Example: RF02, RF07, RNF01 -->

## Feature diagram or documentation

Include diagrams, flowcharts, mockups, or other documentation that helps describe the functionality in greater detail.

<!-- Optional -->
